info.computera.basics: Copper Wire is Computera's standalone wiring component crafted from any copper ingots. Craft the Computera Manual for an in-game guide covering clusters, scripting, logistics, and displays.
info.computera.cabinet: The Computer Cabinet is the core of a Computera cluster. Holds up to 8 Compute Cards (for cluster threads), 2 Hard Drives, up to 64 stored scripts, and a 1,000,000 FE power buffer. Up to 32 cabinets can link face-to-face or over Data Cable (up to 64 blocks).
info.computera.compute_cards: Compute Cards install into a Computer Cabinet (up to 8 per cabinet) to add execution threads for terminals and running scripts: Tier I = 2, II = 4, III = 8, IV = 16, V = 32 threads (up to 8,192 threads per cluster).
info.computera.crate: Modular storage block providing 27 slots per block. Face-to-face adjacent Crates automatically merge into a single shared inventory of up to 64 Crates (1,728 slots) accessible as one container on the logistics network.
info.computera.display_panel: Place Network Display panels on block faces; adjacent panels facing the same direction merge into a multi-block wall (up to 512 panels) showing Overview, Items, or Containers telemetry. Right-click to open a cluster terminal, or sneak-right-click to inspect wall status.
info.computera.eu_adapter: Optional IC2: The New Era power bridge (1 EU = 4 FE, LV 32 EU/t, 25,000 EU / 100,000 FE buffer). Feeds adjacent Computer Cabinets or connected Data Cable clusters; also operates as a standard FE buffer when IC2 is not installed.
info.computera.logistics_pipe: Connects Logistics Ports and Computer Cabinets across the cluster to move items automatically. Each Logistics Pipe adds 4 items/tick of network transfer throughput.
info.computera.logistics_port: Attach to any item container and link into a cluster. Unfiltered ports act as item sources; right-click with an item to set a destination filter (sneak-right-click empty-handed to clear). Logistics Pipes move matching items from sources to filtered destinations.
info.computera.networking: Data Cable links Computer Cabinets, Terminals, Logistics Ports, and Display Panels into a single cluster (up to 64 blocks). Use a Network Connector on a Cabinet to set a hub, then right-click containers (sneak-right-click to unlink) to bind up to 64 wireless containers.
info.computera.punch_machine: Place adjacent to a Terminal. Right-click with a Blank Punched Card to punch the file currently open in the terminal onto a Programmed Card, or right-click with a Programmed Card to load its script into the cluster cabinet.
info.computera.storage_media: Hard Drives slot into Computer Cabinets (hd1:/hd2:) or transfer scripts via export/import. Flash Modules provide portable script transfer. Paper Tape loads into Teletype Terminals (8,192 lines per roll).
info.computera.terminal_crt: Graphical cluster console for managing scripts, automation rules, network logistics, and Display Walls. Draws 3 FE/t from the cluster's Computer Cabinet while open or running a program.
info.computera.terminal_teletype: Power-free command-line terminal operating on Paper Tape (right-click with Paper Tape to load 8,192 lines per roll). Runs Computera scripts and logistics commands without requiring FE/EU power.
